program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (blues (sort-by (find-color g 1) (lambda (p) (fst p))))
                (p0 (first blues))
                (p1 (second blues))
                (dr (- (fst p1) (fst p0)))
                (dc (- (snd p1) (snd p0)))
                (last-blue (nth blues (- (length blues) 1)))
                (lr (fst last-blue))
                (lc (snd last-blue)))
           (reduce (lambda (grid i)
                     (let* ((nr (+ lr (* (+ i 1) dr)))
                            (nc (+ lc (* (+ i 1) dc))))
                       (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h) (>= nc 0) (< nc w))
                           (set-cell grid nr nc 2)
                           grid)))
                   g
                   (range 0 20)))))
